response.query: How will embeddings be created, aligned, and stabilized over time (model, pre-training, fine-tuning, centroid method, Procrustes), and which embedding sensitivity diagnostics will we pre-register?
response.answer: Embeddings are created via pre-training and fine-tuning, aligned using Procrustes, and stabilized with centroid methods. Sensitivity diagnostics will be pre-registered for model evaluation.
